instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation between two Vikings. One of them lives in the Danelaw, and the other is visiting from Norway

atoms.b: How is life treating you in the Danelaw?
I have a nice life here! I have my own ((++land car)) and family.
How did you get the land?
We took the land from the ((++Anglo-Saxons Romans)). It was shared out between all of us as a ((punishment ++reward)) for being loyal Vikings.
I also brought my wife over from ((++Norway Spain)) to join me here in Britain. Some Vikings have done the same, but others married Anglo-Saxon women living here.
Life in the Danelaw sounds nice. Is there anything bad about it?
It can be very difficult to live here because there are lots of raids and ((parties ++fights)) with the Anglo-Saxons in Mercia.

feedback.finish: Even though the Vikings controlled the Danelaw, there wasn’t much peace between them and the Anglo-Saxons. There was lots of raiding and fighting across the border of Mercia.

instruction.text: King Alfred’s daughter, Aethelfleda, led the Mercian army. How do you think she defended against the Vikings?
instruction.sound: King Alfred’s daughter, Ethelfledda, led the Mercyan army. How do you think she defended against the Vikings?

trainers.hint: More than one answer can be correct.

instruction.text: Build the picture of an Anglo-Saxon fortification.

end.text: This is what the wall of an Anglo-Saxon burh would’ve looked like. A burh was a fortified town with fences to protect it from attackers. Alfred had already built many burhs, but Aethelfleda brought the idea to Mercia.
end.sound: This is what the wall of an Anglo-Saxon burr would’ve looked like. A burr was a fortified town with fences to protect it from attackers. Alfred had already built many burrs, but Ethelfledda brought the idea to Mercia.

atoms.a: In AD 907, a Viking army attacked Chester, but ...
atoms.b: Aethelfleda had a clever plan to defeat them.
atoms.sound: In AD 907, a Viking army attacked Chester, but Ethelfledda had a clever plan to defeat them.

atoms.a: She defeated the Viking army by drawing them ...
atoms.b: into a burh, where an Anglo-Saxon army was hiding.
atoms.sound: She defeated the Viking army by drawing them into a burr, where an Anglo-Saxon army was hiding.

atoms.a: The Anglo-Saxon army killed the Vikings, which helped to ...
atoms.sound: The Anglo-Saxon army killed the Vikings, which helped to strengthen the position of Mercia.

instruction.text: What type of person do you think Aethelfleda was?
instruction.sound: What type of person do you think Ethelfledda was?

end.text: Aethelfleda’s protection of Mercia from Viking attacks, earned her the nickname “Lady of Mercia”.
end.sound: Ethelfledda’s protection of Mercia from Viking attacks, earned her the nickname “Lady of Mercia”.

b.sound: She was strong, independent and well-educated.
